name: nightcap
title: Nightcap
description: A cocktail-bar theme whose masthead is a closed matchbook — the bar's name in deco capitals on a peacock-teal cover the full width of the page, a speckled sandpaper striker and one brass staple along its lower edge — with the drinks list printed in teal on the cream inside cover, and the same matchbook on a black-walnut bar top after dark.

tokens.--font-display: the deco capitals: the site title, menu links, page titles, headings, drink names, prices, small labels, table headings and the button
tokens.--font-body: body text, and the italic of descriptions, hours and notes
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-title: letter spacing of the site title on the cover and of the section names on the menu
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of every other line of capitals: menu links, headings, labels, the button
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the cream inside of the matchbook by day, the walnut bar top at night
tokens.--color-text: body text, page titles and drink names
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: descriptions, dates, small labels, page numbers
tokens.--color-accent: links, prices, section names, small headings, the stepped and double rules, list markers, the frame round the menu card, and focus rings on the page
tokens.--color-card: background of the framed menu card, the single-drink card, the 404 card and the skip link
tokens.--color-rule: thin dividing lines: in tables, between news items, above tags and above the notes on a drink's page
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code and code blocks
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadows under the striker flap, the staple and the hours card
tokens.--color-cover: the printed matchbook card: the masthead cover and its flap, the hours card, the footer and the booking button
tokens.--color-cover-ray: the darker rays of the sunburst printed on the cover, and the fine edge lines of the flap and the footer strip
tokens.--color-cover-ink: everything printed on the cover card: the site title, menu links, keyline frames, hours-card text, footer text, the button's label — and the button itself inside the hours card
tokens.--color-striker: the sandpaper striker strip under the cover and along the top of the footer
tokens.--color-striker-grit: the dark grains in the striker, and the hairline round the staple
tokens.--color-striker-fleck: the pale grains in the striker
tokens.--color-brass-light: the highlight along the top of the staple, and the line under the current menu link
tokens.--color-brass-dark: the shaded underside of the staple
tokens.--measure: width of the text column, the menu card and the news list
tokens.--measure-wide: widest a page title may run before it wraps
tokens.--striker-height: height of the flap at the foot of the cover, striker strip included
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the hours card, the button, images and code
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavier lines: the keyline frames of the cover, the hours card and the menu card, the thick stroke of the double rules, the line under the current menu link
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a drink and its description, inside hours-card rows
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between lines on the cover, under small labels
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on phones, gap between drinks and between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks: above headings, round the hours card
tokens.--space-5: large gap above page titles and at the foot of the page
